document:0:637:0.text:
Ever since my memory started slipping, I've been hiding away in this tree hollow.

The terrain makes this place hard for others to reach. And the barriers Bessie and I built make it just as hard for me to escape.

Bessie refuses to give up on me, so she still comes to visit from time to time. But I worry it's too dangerous, so I suggested we keep in touch through a shared journal instead.

I don't want to hurt her. I know exactly what's going to happen to me.

It's only been two days since I saw her, and already her face is blurring in my mind...

I must remind her to reinforce the barriers...

What is... her name again...
document:0:637:0.source_cn:
自从记忆出现问题，我就一直躲在这处树洞中，深居简出。
此处地形复杂，外人难以深入，有了我和蓓丝安合力设置的封锁，我也很难逃脱。
她还不想放弃，经常来探望我，和我说些话。我觉得这样不安全，就提议用交换日记的方式来交流。
因为我不想伤害蓓丝安。我太清楚我会变成什么样了。
上次见面不过两天，我已经不太记得她的模样……
必须跟她说，再加几道封锁……
她……名字是……
